spec.reason: Ranked first because cartservice is a single replica with a 128 Mi limit, reach 1.0 across all five flows, and is shared by frontend and checkoutservice on the revenue path. A prior 110 MB cartservice stress run caused errors across all flows, was guard-aborted, and restarted the pod, so this is a directly shopper-visible, high-blast-radius resource-exhaustion demonstration. The validator accepted this configuration.
spec.hypothesis: The 110 MB allocation will exhaust cartservice's memory headroom, causing an OOM/restart and failures or severe latency across cart-dependent shopper flows; the safety guard will likely remove the fault before 30 seconds elapse.
